_comment: Per-1M-token USD on Vertex AI, ~2026-07. VERIFY against current Google Cloud / Anthropic pricing before quoting. Global endpoints; regional/multi-region carry a ~10% premium.
_gemini_flash_note: gemini_flash tracks Gemini 3.6 Flash (the default `flash` tier as of 2026-07): out dropped 9.00 -> 7.50 vs 3.5 Flash; in and cached-in unchanged. Gemini cached input is a FLAT 0.15/M, not cache_read_mult x in — see _cache_note.
_cache_note: cache_write_mult / cache_read_mult apply to the CLAUDE deck only. Gemini prices cached input at a flat rate (0.15/M for 3.6 Flash) and bills context-cache STORAGE by time, which agy does not report — so any Gemini-side figure you compute here is a LOWER BOUND.
